text:
tara: deploy-bot flagged embeddings throughput drop (v11-quant) on prod-canary - throughput 60r/s -> 35r/s, errors up slightly. Autopilot suggested rollback. https://grafana/embeds/tt1 :eyes:

deploy-bot: autopilot:recommend_rollback rollout/2026-03-22T14:45:11Z reason: throughput_drop>30%. Action: approve rollback to v11-quant-stable or manual mitigation.

leo: pinging @ops-sre @cs-eng. This is embeddings-heavy traffic; customers using batch embeddings may be impacted. Can we do a traffic-slice redirect instead of global rollback?

ops-sre: quick check: one inference shard shows long GC cycles after quantization change. Not universal. Suggested: pin affected shard to v11-stable and re-route 25% of embeddings traffic away while we investigate.

tara: agree with pin+slice. Manual rollback would be noisy for hosted customers. If pin+slice doesn't restore throughput in 10m, we escalate to full rollback.

cs-eng: drafting customer blurb: "We're routing a portion of embeddings traffic to a stable model to maintain performance; some customers may see marginal delays while we investigate." Want to wait until slice is up.

leo: running command: `releases/pin --shard shard-7 --model v11-stable --duration 1h` then `routing/adjust --service embeddings --slice shard-7:25%->v11-stable`

(deploy updates)

deploy-bot: change detected: shard-7 pinned -> v11-stable (expires in 1h). Routing adjusted: shard-7 25% -> v11-stable.

ops-sre: after slice, throughput on affected customers rose to 58r/s, errors back to baseline. GC traces attached.

tara: holding autopilot action. Keep pinned for 1h, ops to capture heap+profiler snapshot and open INF-5502. If reoccurs, we'll revert full rollout.

cs-eng: sending customer note now.

leo: thx all. minimal blast for now; will follow-up in postmortem. :white_check_mark:
